title: Vegan Bravas Fritters
description: Crispy fritters filled with a flavorful bravas-inspired filling, perfect for a vegan snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped lonion, lpeppery, vegan breadcrumbs, and vegan egg replacement.
Add the bravas sauce and mix until a dough forms.
Heat a non-stick pan with a drizzle of olive oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the pan, flattening them slightly with a spatula.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Note: You can also bake the fritters in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
